description.message: Klin's start page and new tab (logo and search bar), and the first-start choice of the search engine. Shows nothing from the internet and keeps no history.

n_about.message: Klin is a free, independent browser built on Firefox. It works for you, not for advertisers: no account, no cloud, no telemetry, and everything stays on your device.

c_lead.message: A search engine receives what you search and your network address. Klin cannot change that: it lets you choose who receives it. Below, what each one is, in facts. You can change the choice at any time with the toolbar button of this extension.

c_suggested.message: Suggested by Klin. Klin receives nothing from it.

c_saved.message: Saved. Klin's start page now searches with {1}.

c_scope.message: This choice is used by the search bar of Klin's start page. The address bar uses the engine set in the browser's search settings (now: {1}).

c_check.message: These facts come from general knowledge and the operators' own descriptions; each is to be checked against the operator's own policy. Klin takes no money from any search engine.
